development area: Digital Workflow Monitoring and Exception Management
description: Ability to oversee, diagnose, and manage fully or partially automated data collection workflows, including real-time monitoring, identifying system failures or data anomalies, and escalating issues appropriately.
historic work: Key Activities: 'Participates in the implementation, conduct and maintenance of manual and automated operations for the collection, coding and processing of data.'
change to work: Implementation and maintenance will become highly automated; focus is now on monitoring, validating, and resolving exceptions in automated/passive collection pipelines, as well as supporting integration of new digital interfaces (APIs, machine-to-machine, event triggers). Manual operations will be rare and limited to non-automatable cases.
justification: Increasing emphasis on understanding and interacting with digital automation platforms and AI-powered tools requires upskilling from basic operational support to digital system/supervision.

development area: Passive/Administrative Data Integration

historic work: Key Activities: 'Participates in the implementation, conduct and maintenance of manual and automated operations for the collection, coding and processing of data.'
change to work: Implementation and maintenance will become highly automated; focus is now on monitoring, validating, and resolving exceptions in automated/passive collection pipelines, as well as supporting integration of new digital interfaces (APIs, machine-to-machine, event triggers). Manual operations will be rare and limited to non-automatable cases.
justification: Passive data collection relies on integration with administrative and system data rather than respondent solicitation. Officers need familiarity with these digital data sources, interfaces, and compliance implications.

development area: AI/ML-Driven Survey and Instrument Evaluation

Recommendations will increasingly need to address digital optimization and compliance, including advice on algorithm, integration, and automation improvements.
justification: AI/ML-based survey design and automated instrument rendering require the officer to understand data science and automation tools well enough to provide meaningful evaluations and recommendations.

development area: Digital Collection Strategy Design
description: Understanding principles of automation-first design, event/trigger-based collection, and technical compliance in digital acquisition strategies.
historic work: Key Activities: 'Evaluates collection and coding methods, procedures and results and recommends alternatives.'
change to work: Evaluation now focuses less on manual procedure review and more on assessment of digital pipeline effectiveness, the suitability and integrity of passive collection mechanisms, and the quality of AI/ML-generated surveys or instruments. Recommendations will increasingly need to address digital optimization and compliance, including advice on algorithm, integration, and automation improvements.

development area: Digital Liaison and Integration Facilitation

change to work: Systems analysis demands greater knowledge of automation, AI/ML-driven survey and collection design, and API/data stream architecture.
